description: Search open vacancies in Cyprus on CyprusJobs.eu by words, town, field, minimum monthly pay, accommodation and language. Returns up to 20 vacancies with pay, town, employer and the link to apply. Applying is free; never pay anyone to get a job.

field.description: Field of work, e.g. hospitality, sales, IT

language.description: Language of the links and labels: en, el (Greek) or ru (Russian)

min_monthly_salary.description: Only vacancies paying at least this many euros gross a month

no_experience.description: Only vacancies open to people without experience

no_greek_needed.description: Only vacancies that ask for English and not Greek

query.description: Words to look for in the job title or company, e.g. 'waiter', 'receptionist', 'accountant'

town.description: Town in Cyprus; leave out for the whole island

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs in Cyprus
